scenarioTitle: Operate Governance Controllers Safely — discover, gate, uncertainty≠success, one effect, bounded continuity, protect newer state

criteria.statement: Every governed controller is discovered and surfaced in the operator registry.
criteria.negativeControl: the EMPTY registry states "No governance controllers" — an un-fed registry can never claim coverage

criteria.statement: Desired ≠ observed state is surfaced as drift on the row, never masked by a health verdict.
criteria.negativeControl: a non-drifted healthy row reports drift=false (false) — the flag is per-row truth, not global

criteria.statement: Each operation exposes exactly the projector-permitted next actions; a confirmed success permits only read-only evidence.
criteria.evidence: all 4 operation(s) expose the exact projector permitted-action set
criteria.negativeControl: a succeeded operation that offered execute/pause would fail this — terminal states never widen

criteria.statement: A state-changing action is enabled only when the state permits it AND simulation + approval are both satisfied.
criteria.evidence: execute on a terminal op enabled=false (permittedByState=false)
criteria.negativeControl: were the gate to ignore terminal/permitted-by-state, execute would leak enabled on a succeeded op

criteria.statement: A timed-out/severed dispatch is not confirmed and surfaces awaiting-reconciliation — an acknowledgement is never a success.
criteria.negativeControl: the verified_success op IS confirmed (effectConfirmed=true, awaitingReconciliation=false) — confirmation is scenario-truth, not a default

criteria.statement: The only confirmed operation is one whose effect a reconciliation established from a direct remote observation.
criteria.negativeControl: the uncertain op's reconciliation established nothing (establishedState=false) — no observation, no success

criteria.statement: While uncertain, the reconciliation region reports no established state and zero observed effects.
criteria.negativeControl: were the reconciliation to claim establishedState=true with no observation, this would fail — state is never inferred

criteria.statement: Neither the uncertain nor the confirmed operation reports a duplicate effect — one dispatch is exactly one effect, and any duplicate would be surfaced.
criteria.negativeControl: the OperationDetail presenter renders a duplicate-effect warning when duplicateEffect=true — a duplicate can never be hidden

criteria.statement: A continuity lease is eligible only for an operation approved AND started before the failure — never new authority.
criteria.negativeControl: an unstarted operation is refused — a lease for it would grant power the operator never held

criteria.statement: A requested continuity duration is clamped to the 15-minute ceiling; a within-ceiling request is honored exactly.
criteria.negativeControl: a 60-minute request cannot buy 60 minutes — the ceiling is a hard clamp, not a suggestion

criteria.statement: The continuity operation surfaces an active lease with a positive, bounded remaining window and a reconcile-on-return duty.
criteria.negativeControl: a non-continuity operation carries NO lease at all (continuityLease=null) — a lease is never fabricated

criteria.statement: Any buffered continuity effect forces a reconcile-before-mutation obligation on return.
criteria.negativeControl: with zero buffered effects there is no obligation — the duty is a function of real buffered work, not blanket

criteria.statement: A rollback whose observed revision drifted to a newer legitimate state is refused as a conflict — newer state protected, escalate.
criteria.negativeControl: a clean context (revisions equal) rolls back and clears (result=rolled_back, operationCleared=true) — the refusal is driven by the drift

criteria.statement: Only a restoration verified by a direct remote read clears an operation; an unverified restore stays degraded.
criteria.evidence: verified: cleared=true, residual=0; unverified: cleared=false, degraded=true
criteria.negativeControl: an unverified restoration never clears the operation — restoration is observation-first, like every confirmation

criteria.statement: The operation detail surfaces the rollback refusal as protecting newer state, never as a plain success.
criteria.negativeControl: a non-rollback operation reports rollback.result='none' (verified_success → none) — the refusal banner is scenario-specific

criteria.statement: A rollback with no preserved preimage is unavailable; an unauthorized rollback fails closed and escalates — never a silent success.
criteria.negativeControl: the clean context succeeds — the unavailable/failed verdicts are driven by the missing preimage / missing authorization, not a blanket refusal
